body.purpose: Subcopy set directly on the pink ground.

label.purpose: Uppercase tags: colorways, ticker items, sticker captions.

script.purpose: Handwritten asides: secondary CTA, Polaroid captions, sticker note.

shadows.name: ground-glow
shadows.value: blur(100-110px) radial field, background-deep/40 and cherry-bright/20
shadows.purpose: Atmospheric glow behind the hero, never used as a card backing. Turned down from 70%/40% when the ground moved from full-saturation pink to near-white blush.

shadows.name: placed-object
shadows.purpose: Soft diffuse shadow under Polaroids, pills, and buttons to read as physically placed on the pink ground.

motion.name: spring-settle
motion.purpose: Polaroid entrance: rotates in from an exaggerated angle and settles.

motion.name: magnetic-hover
motion.value: type: spring, stiffness 150, damping 12, mass 0.4, translate toward cursor * 0.35/0.45
motion.purpose: Nav cart button and primary CTA follow the cursor slightly before release.

motion.name: float-bob
motion.purpose: Idle float for scattered stickers and the season badge.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cherry pill CTA with magnetic hover and a spring tap-scale; used once per view for the single primary action.
components.html: Shop the edit
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:56px; padding:16px 20px 16px 28px; border-radius:9999px; background:#c81846; color:#fff8ef; font-family:'Fredoka',ui-rounded,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; box-shadow:0 20px 35px -15px rgba(200,24,70,0.4); transition:background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#ff2d55; transform:scale(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #c81846; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary-arrow { width:16px; height:16px; transition:transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-primary-arrow { transform:translate(2px,-2px); }

components.name: Polaroid Card
components.description: Rotated cream-mounted photo card with a washi-tape strip and a handwritten caption; the only way product photography ships in this world.
components.css: .ds-polaroid { position:relative; background:#fff8ef; border-radius:18px; padding:10px 10px 24px; box-shadow:0 25px 50px -12px rgba(214,41,126,0.3); transform:rotate(-7deg); transition:transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-polaroid:hover { transform:rotate(0deg) scale(1.04); } .ds-polaroid-window { position:relative; height:220px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:10px; background:#ffeee0; outline:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); outline-offset:-1px; } .ds-polaroid-window img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; } .ds-polaroid-tape { position:absolute; top:-10px; left:50%; width:56px; height:20px; background:rgba(255,210,63,0.9); transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg); border-radius:2px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); } .ds-polaroid-caption { position:absolute; bottom:6px; left:12px; font-family:'Caveat',cursive; font-size:16px; color:rgba(43,21,18,0.7); }

components.name: Nav Pill
components.description: Floating cream pill bar carrying the logo, link pills, and cart button, sitting with margin over the pink ground rather than spanning edge to edge.
components.html:
Zella
ShirtsTrousersOur Story
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; background:rgba(255,248,239,0.95); border-radius:9999px; padding:10px 10px 10px 20px; box-shadow:0 10px 25px -10px rgba(214,41,126,0.2); } .ds-nav-logo { font-family:'Bagel Fat One',ui-rounded,sans-serif; font-size:24px; color:#2b1512; } .ds-nav-links { display:flex; gap:4px; font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; color:rgba(43,21,18,0.8); } .ds-nav-links a { padding:8px 16px; border-radius:9999px; transition:background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { background:#ffeee0; color:#c81846; } .ds-nav-cart { width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:9999px; background:#c81846; color:#fff8ef; border:none; }

components.name: Ticker Band
components.description: Full-width cream marquee closing the hero, reading like a charm-bracelet strip of product facts.
components.css: .ds-ticker { overflow:hidden; background:#fff8ef; border-top:4px solid rgba(255,248,239,0.4); padding:16px 0; } .ds-ticker-track { display:flex; gap:40px; width:max-content; animation:ds-marquee 22s linear infinite; } .ds-ticker-track span { font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:0.25em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#c81846; white-space:nowrap; } @keyframes ds-marquee { from { transform:translateX(0);} to { transform:translateX(-50%);} }

components.name: Sticker Badge
components.description: Idle-floating circular Cherry badge that carries supplementary tags (season, promo) instead of a kicker line above the heading.
components.css: .ds-sticker { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:2px; width:96px; height:96px; border-radius:9999px; background:#c81846; color:#fff8ef; text-align:center; box-shadow:0 20px 35px -15px rgba(214,41,126,0.4); animation:ds-float 5.5s ease-in-out infinite; transform:rotate(-8deg); } .ds-sticker-script { font-family:'Caveat',cursive; font-size:20px; line-height:1; } .ds-sticker-label { font-family:'Fredoka',sans-serif; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } @keyframes ds-float { 0%,100% { transform:translateY(0) rotate(-8deg);} 50% { transform:translateY(-14px) rotate(-4deg);} }

narrative.overview: Zella's storefront reads like a Pinterest mood board a shopper built for her own closet: a Polaroid stack of real cotton shirts taped down at jaunty angles on a whisper-soft blush field, a chunky bubble-letter headline that refuses to whisper, and a handful of stickers (a bow, a heart, a sparkle) idle-floating around the edges like someone doodled on the page. It replaces the site's original quiet-luxury cream/serif ecommerce default on purpose. An initial version drenched the ground in full-saturation hot pink; user feedback moved it to a near-white blush and let cherry-red alone carry the energy. Cream is reserved for content-bearing surfaces, so the product photography and the copy always land on a calm, high-contrast surface.
keyCharacteristics: Whisper-blush ground with a single loud cherry-red action color; cream reserved for content-bearing surfaces.
Bagel Fat One (bubble display) + Fredoka (rounded body/UI) + Caveat (handwritten script).
Product photography always framed as a taped Polaroid, never a bare rectangular crop.
Bouncy, physical motion (spring easing, idle float, magnetic hover), not a uniform fade.
No kickers/eyebrows above headings — supplementary tags live on rotated sticker badges instead.

rules.name: The No-Fade-On-Pink Rule
rules.body: Text sitting directly on the Hot Pink ground is always full-opacity Espresso Ink, never a translucent tint of it.

rules.name: The Colorway-Swatch Rule
rules.body: The colorway swatches sample real product photography colors, never the decorative pop accents.

rules.name: The One-Display-Face Rule
rules.body: Bagel Fat One appears only on the H1; every other loud moment stays in Fredoka at heavier weight.

rules.name: The Physical-Object Rule
rules.body: Only elements meant to read as objects sitting on the pink ground get a shadow; the ground and its glow blobs never do.

dos: Do keep the pink ground at full saturation across an entire section.
Do frame every piece of real product photography as a taped Polaroid.
Do use Espresso Ink at full opacity for any text set directly on the pink ground.
Do give interactive elements spring/magnetic motion rather than a linear ease.
donts: Don't add a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't fade ink to gray for secondary text on the pink ground.
Don't introduce a second display face.
Don't re-saturate the ground back toward full-strength pink; the near-white Blush ground is a confirmed user correction.
